# elemento_registry (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Elemento registry resource on the cloud selected by `target`. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing_uuid` (String) Portal billing UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.
- `uuid` (String) Service UUID. Set exactly one of `uuid` or `billing_uuid`.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) Access key ID for the registry.
- `billing_frequency` (String) Billing period.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `creator_uuid` (String) UUID of the account that created the resource.
- `image_count` (Number) Number of images stored.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the registry is reachable from the public internet.
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last update.
- `login_command` (String, Sensitive) Command that logs in to the registry.
- `name` (String) Name of the registry.
- `region` (String) Region the resource is in.
- `registry_id` (String) ID of the registry.
- `registry_type` (String) Registry type.
- `repository_uri` (String) URI of the repository.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key for the resource.
- `size_gb` (Number) Storage size in GB.
- `state` (String) Current state reported by the service.
- `status` (String) Current status of the resource.
- `used_bytes` (Number) Storage in use, in bytes.
